toolsPreview.name: get_quote
toolsPreview.description: Get a swap quote (route, expected out, 2% fee disclosed) for inputMint→outputMint of amount in base units.

toolsPreview.name: check_token_safety
toolsPreview.description: Rug-gate a token: honeypot, mint/freeze authority, liquidity lock, holder concentration.

toolsPreview.name: find_gems
toolsPreview.description: Rug-gated new/trending tokens. tab: new | trending | graduated.

toolsPreview.name: get_token_info
toolsPreview.description: Live price, liquidity and market cap for a mint.

toolsPreview.name: list_tradeable_tokens
toolsPreview.description: Every token swappable on the DEX.

toolsPreview.name: build_swap
toolsPreview.description: Build an UNSIGNED swap transaction (2% fee baked in) + a build_id. Requires an API key. Sign it locally with your own wallet, then call submit_swap with the same build_id. Your key never leaves your environment.

toolsPreview.name: submit_swap
toolsPreview.description: Broadcast an already-signed swap transaction with its build_id. Requires an API key. Returns the signature and confirmation status.
